_comment: Config for dfm_audit — the deterministic gate for step 10 (3D + DFM). Read-only, pure-Python (no kicad-cli): parses the .kicad_pcb for the manufacturability checks DRC can't see. Every reference designator is present (annotated), silkscreen text is legible (>= the board's own min height/width), connectors are flagged for a human orientation/keying confirm (Appendix A — the highest-risk category), and the board outline dimensions are reported for confirmation. Connector classification reuses footprint_audit's DYNAMIC refdes triage (one source of truth). Cached; RESTART backend after edits. Verdict in words.
_rule_source: Master flow step 10 (3D+DFM) + Appendix A connector guardrail + PCB_RULES silk/DFM section.

refdes_present._rule: Rule 3 — every footprint must carry a real reference designator. A placeholder (REF**) or empty ref = unannotated board; assembly can't place it.

silk_legible._rule: Rule 3 — silkscreen text must be >= the board's own min text height / stroke width (from .kicad_pro, else fab floor). Too-small silk won't print legibly.

connector_orientation._rule: Rule 2 + Appendix A — connectors/mechanical parts are the highest-risk category; a mirrored connector is electrically valid but physically useless. Every one is flagged for a REQUIRED human orientation / pin-1 / keying confirm.

board_outline._rule: Rule 5 — the board outline (Edge.Cuts) dimensions are reported for a final confirm; a missing outline is a hard flag. If expected_board_mm is set, mismatch beyond tolerance is flagged.

model_3d._rule: Rule 1 — a footprint with no 3D (model ...) reference can't be height/clash-checked in the 3D view. Info-only.

_exempt_note: A footprint with NO numbered pad (mounting hole / logo) OR carrying one of these (attr ...) flags (fiducials + mounting holes are exclude_from_pos_files) is a fab feature, not an assembled BOM part — exempt from the refdes + 3D-model checks (it still gets silk-legibility, and the connector-orientation check still runs on every footprint since it's refdes-driven). Fully dynamic: derived from the footprint's own pads + attr, no per-name list.

expected_board_mm._comment: Optional mechanical spec to check the outline against. null = just report the measured W x H. When set to [w, h], an outline outside tolerance_mm is flagged.

verdict.clean: DFM VERIFIED — {n} parts annotated, silk legible, outline {dims}
verdict.issues: DFM NOT CLEAN — {e} error(s), {w} warning(s), {r} human-confirm across {n} parts
verdict.review_only: DFM OK — {n} parts, {r} connector(s) need a human orientation confirm; outline {dims}
verdict.no_parts: NO PARTS — board has no footprints to check
